alt.en: A standing page with lines of writing at the front left sends a dashed orange line with one packet into a large blue neural network card in the center. A second orange line runs from the card to a violet dial on the right, and a dotted gray line leads to an indigo row of log blocks at the back.
alt.zh: 左前方一页写有横线的文件，经一条带数据块的橙色虚线连到中央的大幅蓝色神经网络卡片；卡片再以橙色线连到右侧紫色表盘，并以灰色点线连到后方一排靛蓝日志方块。

caption.en: Illustration: a prompt passes through a mixture-of-experts model, a dial stands for evaluating refusal behavior, and a log stands for a checkable record of the serving configuration. It does not depict the authors' models, vLLM setup or measurements, and it does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：提示词经过混合专家模型处理，表盘代表拒答表现评估，日志代表可核查的服务配置记录。图中并非作者的模型、vLLM 配置或测量结果，也不代表任何经过测试的部署。
